changes: Makes exhausted Smart Import retries terminal until explicit Retry Import, preventing infinite completion-loop churn.
Removes unsafe recent-output guessing: Smart Import now requires an explicit SAB path or exact job/release folder ownership proof before importing media.
Adds TV franchise/edition identity validation so generic Love Island/Big Brother items cannot consume Australia/US/Canada/Games/Beyond or other mismatched releases.
Throttles Smart Import heartbeat/progress persistence to at most once every five seconds while keeping in-memory progress responsive.
Shares sub-second successful SAB Queue reads between fast UI snapshots, polls lifetime download statistics every 30 seconds, and adds startup recovery cooldown after failed launches.
Persists stale ownership release state so cross-runtime ledger merging cannot resurrect and re-log the same stale record thousands of times.
Adds a read-only library integrity audit for duplicate fingerprints across targets and TV edition mismatches, surfaced in Copy Diagnostics and via API.
Adds Remove all failed to the Downloads Failed view, removing all failed/attention downloads through one batch control request instead of requiring individual Remove clicks.
regression_guards: v3.6.24 durable Download Statistics remain persistent and accurate.
v3.6.23 accent-insensitive title matching such as 90 Day Fiancé / 90 Day Fiance remains accepted.
v3.6.22 unresolved/obfuscated binary downloads and root placement remain unchanged.
v3.6.21 Related Media/image browsing and v3.6.20 authoritative SAB Queue/History behavior remain intact.
Automation queue depth remains bounded; no destructive library repair is performed automatically.
name: Automation Backlog & Smart Import Reliability
